attributes.name: section divider style
attributes.definition: Whether section edges use decorative textured or hand-made dividers (brush-stroke, torn-paint, etc.) versus plain edges.

values.definition: Section edges use brush-stroke, torn-paper/paint or similar ornamental dividers.
Section edges are straight/clean with no ornamental divider treatment.
Another divider treatment such as waves, angles or lines.

attributes.name: corner radius
attributes.definition: The degree of rounding on corners of boxes, cards, buttons and other containers.

values.definition: Corners are sharp or essentially unrounded.
Small radii, subtle softening of corners.
Large radii, pill or heavily rounded shapes.
Varies by component or not determinable.
